scope: Failures observed while developing the 3.14 research fixtures; retained after fixes. These are isolated synthetic fixtures, not user archives or target-GPU evidence.

failures.fixture: qa/research-safety-3.14-dom-check.mjs / maximum rate request save and reload
failures.observation: Reloaded rate inputs were [] instead of [360,-120].
failures.rootCause: saveDraft removed the edited program and appended it at the end. Reload selected the first other program, making a valid saved edit appear absent.
failures.change: Replace an existing program at its original list index; append only a genuinely new program.
failures.assertionPreserved: Maximum roll/pitch requests survive editor, save and reload; actual values remain 360 and -120.

failures.fixture: tests/research-platform-3.14.test.mjs / invalid body state before controller decision
failures.observation: Error: 快照不可恢复：包含非有限数; captureExperimentSnapshot threw during LandingTaskRunner.finish after the bounded controller had disabled itself.
failures.rootCause: The controller detected a non-finite observation before the next physics sanity pass. There was no physics failure report yet, and result finalization still attempted a complete finite snapshot.
failures.change: captureTerminalState catches unavailable full continuation, retains serializable invalid-field descriptions and last finite telemetry, marks diagnostic-only terminalReplayable=false, and releases the research command.
failures.acceptanceClarification: Two separate injection points remain covered: corruption after control decision reaches the physics safety path and yields solver_fault; corruption before decision yields controller_fault plus explicit terminal_capture_failed event. No reset state is used as the terminal and no exact continuation is claimed.

failures.evidenceLevel: Source-confirmed development-candidate gaps; the added boundary suite exercises each corrected branch. No target-browser exploit or remote code execution is claimed.
failures.observation: The previous state importer accepted extra fields, sparse states and arbitrary fault payloads; duplicate tick at the same decision step could integrate again. The previous Worker onerror callback had no job generation check.
failures.change: Exact data/descriptor/state contracts, node-specific state limits, bounded fault payloads, same-step idempotence and ordered declared decision steps; old Worker callbacks ignored, concurrent requests refused, malformed result/cancel failures close the current job with a persisted attempt.
failures.acceptance: tests/research-boundaries-3.14.test.mjs retains prototype/accessor, overflow, exact-state continuation, real Node Worker cancel/concurrency and isolated DOM stale-callback/protectedRaw fixtures.
